blocks.text:
After breakfast, another half-day excursion (4 hours), through the lush Tijuca Forest, one of the largest urban forests in the world, home to an extraordinary variety of tropical flora and fauna, to the summit of Corcovado, where Christ the Redeemer overlooks the city. Named one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, the monument offers breathtaking panoramic views of Rio, its famous beaches, mountains and Guanabara Bay.

The statue was erected in 1931 and stands 38 metres tall at an altitude of 710 metres above sea level. From the viewing platform, you can see the Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf and other parts of the city.
